note: A bare `*` as a DC data element is the ADDRESS of this point: a coefficient-1 self-segment relocation (SEGNAME + baked seg-relative offset), not an assembly-time literal. omf.py DC element loop `_star_elem` — the assembler bakes the segment-relative location (incl. any +/-const addend) into the literal bytes, and the emitter now wraps them in an 0xF3 SEGNAME expression; ORG'd/temporg segments keep the plain literal. discovered: NetBoot Logon.Main `VolName DC.L *` — golden Apple //e Boot Blocks ships $835B (placed) where gsasm baked $2073 (seg-relative). The only such element in the corpus.
